summary: On the seat's own host, an agent card's freshness and the assistant's seat counts use the newest local harness report of the seat's incarnation, so a resting seat whose unchanged re-stamps stay local reads current there instead of stale after 90 seconds

replay.detail: No claim is written or read differently; nothing replays.

schema.detail: No schema change: the read is one seek in the existing local_observations_subject_kind_index.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: A card's observation (current, stale), the lapse of a stale idle report to waiting and the down rule read the later of the replicated report's time and, on the node that runs the seat, its newest local harness.observed of the same incarnation. Local observations never replicate, so only that node has one, and every other member reads the replicated report as before. No field, wire or CLI shape changes; an older node keeps reading the replicated report alone.

downtime.detail: No restart beyond the normal upgrade; no migration or backfill.

recovery.detail: No data recovery is needed. Reverting makes the host's cards read the replicated report alone again.
